<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/gift-lists/{postId}/draw"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Starter only, once, with the draw enabled and at least 3
participants. Everyone gives to exactly one other participant and
never to someone they're excluded with; `400` when no such draw
exists. Every participant gets a `gift_draw` notification, which never
names their recipient.
